test_title: PYST 9 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A and B invest ₹30,000 and ₹50,000 respectively. After 6 months, C joins with ₹60,000. What will be the ratio of their profits at the end of the year?
solution:
**Given:**

A invests ₹30,000 for 12 months

B invests ₹50,000 for 12 months

C invests ₹60,000 for 6 months

**Formula used:**

Profit share is proportional to the product of investment and time.

Profit share = Investment × Time
